figure_candidates.label: Figure 12
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 12. Observation of the membrane phase state of streptolactam D (1)-producing strain using 1,6-diphenyl-1,3,5-hexatriene (DPH) and
LipiORDER. (a) Schematic diagram showing the relationship between the fluorescence anisotropy value (r) and cell membrane fluidity. (b) Effect
of 1 on fluorescence anisotropy values of various membrane lipids, such as cardiolipin (CL), phosphatidylethanolamine (PE), and
phosphatidylglycerol (PG), using DPH. DPH was added at 1 mol % of the mixture of each lipid and 1. All data presented as mean ± SD (n = 3; *p
< 0.05, **p < 0.01, ***p < 0.001; one-tailed Student’s t test). (c) Schematic diagram showing the mechanism of LipiORDER. (d, e) Observation of
membrane phase state at each incubation time. Upper: 2 days; lower: 5 days. (f, g) Observation of the effect of 1 (2 μg) on the phase state of the
membrane. Upper: without addition of 1; lower: with addition of 1.
